description: This file contains utility functions for defining window specifications in DataFrames, specifically functions for creating partitioning and ordering window specifications using Spark's Window API.

methods.name: windowPartitionBy
methods.description: Creates a WindowSpec with the partitioning defined, either from character column names or Column objects.

methods.name: windowOrderBy
methods.description: Creates a WindowSpec with the ordering defined, either from character column names or Column objects.
